description: fakek8sjob/v1 — Simulation leaf that fakes 'run a team's Kubernetes Job'. Input is spec.image (a Docker repository:tag, e.g. nginx:1.27); on reconcile it pretends to submit a Job running that image and writes a deterministic fake Job status. The SECOND half of the demo's second DAG: it depends on a faketerraform upstream, and the engine flows that apply's status.image_tag into spec.built_image — so the Job runs the image the team's Terraform built (built wins over the literal image). Teams apply it DECLARATIVELY via a celbom rule or a stdstarlark policy.

image.description: Docker image to run (repository:tag), e.g. nginx:1.27. The literal input set in the team's policy.

built_image.description: Image flowed in from an upstream faketerraform apply (status.image_tag); preferred over image when present.

ran_image.description: The image the Job actually ran (built_image wins over the literal image).
